root_cause.text: Missing bounds checks on `ie_length` before subtracting fixed IE offsets (`_FIXED_IE_LENGTH_` and `_BEACON_IE_OFFSET_`) in `rtw_is_desired_network`, causing unsigned integer underflow and potential out-of-bounds read when `ie_length` is smaller than the offset.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (pnetwork->network.ie_length < _FIXED_IE_LENGTH_) return false;` and wraps the second subtraction with `if (pnetwork->network.ie_length < _BEACON_IE_OFFSET_) { bselected = false; } else { ... }`, explicitly to prevent unsigned integer underflow as stated in the commit message.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add length validation before parsing RSN IE to avoid out-of-bounds access when ie_length is smaller than the beacon offset.
intent_record.what: Added a guard condition checking if pnetwork->network.ie_length is less than _BEACON_IE_OFFSET_ before calling rtw_get_ie; if true, sets bselected = false and skips the RSN IE parsing.
intent_record.how: Prevents potential out-of-bounds access when computing the length argument (ie_length - _BEACON_IE_OFFSET_) and ensures safe handling of malformed or short beacon frames.
